You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many cakes did Rose buy over all three days? Rose bought 4 cakes at a store on Monday. Rose bought three times as many cakes on Tuesday as she bought on Monday at a different store. Rose bought five times as many cakes on Wednesday as she bought on Tuesday at another store.
